Weather colors should remain natural and recognizable. It will be composited with other separate weather pieces at 24-48px, so use broad simple shapes, crisp silhouette, no fine texture. No face, character, lettering, numerals, UI frame, scenery, floor, atmospheric background, other weather symbols, or external cast shadow. Center the complete object with a small transparent margin. No detached rays or sparkles.
